entries.caption_claim: Table II reports the unified HAI 21.03 benchmark at the prespecified Q0.995 calibration threshold.

supported_manuscript_claims.claim: The full model was not the strongest model; the TCN autoencoder had the highest baseline Macro AP and the TCN predictor had the highest point F1.

limitations: The five test files are dependent sequences from one HAI system.
Only three optimization seeds were run.
The table does not compare recent deep detectors under the same protocol.

entries.caption_claim: Table III reports seed-level Macro AP for all full-model score combinations and the three matched objective removals.

supported_manuscript_claims.claim: Reconstruction plus prediction slightly exceeded all-score fusion, and removing the contrastive objective improved matched Macro AP by 0.1268.

limitations: Removal deltas are descriptive means over three seeds, not significance estimates.
The conclusion is specific to the declared objective weights, augmentations, and HAI release.

entries.caption_claim: Figure 2 plots full-model point F1, coverage-aware event recall, and false-alarm events per normal hour across the calibration-quantile grid, with the prespecified Q0.995 threshold marked.

supported_manuscript_claims.claim: Higher thresholds reduce false alarms but lower 50% coverage recall and increase detection delay.

limitations: The threshold grid is a post hoc sensitivity analysis and does not redefine the primary operating point.
Error bars summarize only three seeds.
Detection delay is conditional on detected events.
